name: Plaisio Code
subtitle: The Plaisio Code iPhone app
description: Add this source to install Plaisio Code and get its updates.

apps.name: Plaisio Code
apps.subtitle: Plaisio product lookup
apps.localizedDescription: Scan a barcode or search to find the Plaisio product code, price and store stock.
apps.versionDescription: Today is now about selling: pick what you're doing (Customer, Labels, Stockroom) and see that mode's goals as rings. Customer tracks sales €, items, warranties and accessories against goals the app sets from your last 7 days, with a streak and badges. New Sold button on the product page records a sale with its warranty and accessories (with Undo). Each mode shows its steps and tools.
